ext_description.message: Hover lookup, grammar and sentence analysis, saving words and sentences to Gum, Anki cards, OCR and page capture.

opt_lookupLead.message: Hold a key and point at text in a language you study to open the reader popup.

opt_hoverEnableSub.message: Hold the activation key and move the cursor over a word.

opt_hoverKeyDesc.message: Held while hovering; also used with click and select lookups.

opt_hoverDelayDesc.message: How long the cursor rests on a word before the popup opens.

opt_scanLengthDesc.message: Maximum characters considered for a match. Longer catches long compounds; shorter is faster.

opt_closeOnRelease.message: Close the popup when the key is released

opt_closeOnReleaseSub.message: Off: the popup stays until you click elsewhere or press Esc. Pinned popups always stay.

opt_clickLookup.message: Key + click / key + select also look up

opt_clickLookupSub.message: Plain clicks always pass through to the page.

opt_lookupEditableSub.message: Off by default so typing is never interrupted.

opt_aiLead.message: Choose what a highlight and an OCR each resolve to. AI OCR annotates the whole sentence — grammar, vocabulary, level, formality and nuance — and lets you card it or snapshot it into the notebook. Dictionary AI keeps the instant offline lookup. The two gestures are set separately.

opt_aiOnHighlight.message: AI OCR when I highlight text

opt_aiOnHighlightSub.message: Off: highlighting opens the dictionary popup as before.

opt_aiOnOcr.message: AI OCR after a screenshot OCR

opt_aiOnOcrSub.message: Off: the OCR result opens with an “AI analysis” button instead.

opt_aiMinCharsDesc.message: Shorter selections stay on the offline dictionary — a one-word cloud call is slower and costs money for an answer the dictionary already has.

opt_aiWhere.message: What the analysis contains, which deck cards go to, and automatic notebook snapshots are set in Gum → Settings → Profile & dictionary → AI analysis. An API key is required (Flashcards → AI Card Studio).

opt_popupLead.message: The in-page dictionary with Meaning, Grammar, Sentence, Kanji, and Examples tabs.

opt_popupCompactSub.message: Fewer definitions per entry — lighter for long reading sessions.

opt_popupPin.message: Pin the popup on key + click

opt_popupPinSub.message: Pinned popups can be dragged by their header and stay open while you read.

opt_popupKeysHtml.message: Inside the popup: <kbd>←</kbd><kbd>→</kbd> switch tabs · <kbd>S</kbd> save word · <kbd>Shift+S</kbd> save sentence · <kbd>C</kbd> create card · <kbd>P</kbd> pin · <kbd>A</kbd> audio · <kbd>Esc</kbd> close.

opt_savingLead.message: Where saved words, sentences, and flashcards go. (Previously called “mining”.)

opt_destLabel.message: When I save a word or sentence

opt_destBothSub.message: Creates an Anki card when Anki is running; a copy is always kept in your Gum library.

opt_destAppSub.message: Saves to your Gum library. “Create card” still sends to Anki explicitly.

opt_confirmCardSub.message: Shows the text, card type, and destination before sending. Card fields are filled by Gum from its dictionaries and your Anki field mapping.

opt_folderLabelDesc.message: Saves from the extension appear under this folder in Gum flashcards.

opt_savingHintHtml.message: Deck, note type, and field mapping live in the Gum app — see Connection for direct links.

opt_wheelLeadHtml.message: A quick action ring opened with <kbd>Alt+Shift+W</kbd>. One command per position; the center always cancels.

opt_wheelEnableSub.message: When disabled, the shortcut opens a compact action list instead.

opt_wheelHintHtml.message: Each command can be assigned once — picking a command that is already placed swaps the two positions. Commands that don't apply to the current page (like Download video outside YouTube) appear disabled on the wheel. Keyboard: <kbd>1</kbd>–<kbd>6</kbd> run a position, arrows move the highlight, <kbd>Esc</kbd> cancels.

opt_panelLead.message: The small corner panel with the difficulty estimate and page tools.

opt_fabClearHidden.message: Show panel on all sites again

opt_fabHint.message: “Hide here” on the panel suppresses it per-site; this clears that list.

opt_mediaLead.message: What “Save page” does on YouTube, and media options.

opt_ytAudioSub.message: Smaller files — useful for listening practice.

opt_mediaHint.message: “Download video” is always available explicitly on YouTube pages from the popup, wheel, and More menu.

opt_connLead.message: Pairing with the Gum desktop app. Everything else — Anki mapping, mining rules, clipboard history — lives in the app itself.

opt_tokenDesc.message: In Gum, open Settings → Profile & dictionary → Chrome extension. Copy the token and paste it here, or press Pair now there and then Pull token from app here.

opt_shortcutsLead.message: Browser-level shortcuts are managed by Chrome; in-page keys work whenever the reader popup or wheel is open.

opt_inPageKeysHtml.message:
Reader popup: ←→ tabs · S save word · Shift+S save sentence · C create card · P pin · A audio · Backspace back · Esc close.
Wheel: 1–6 run · arrows highlight · Enter run · Esc cancel.
OCR selection: drag a box · Esc cancel.

opt_advancedLead.message: Data, migration, and everything that doesn't need to be on by default.

opt_logImmersionSub.message: Counts active time on pages in a language you study toward your immersion statistics.

opt_resetHint.message: Reset keeps your pairing token and port. Settings from older versions (including “Prefer Anki for mines” and the old wheel slots) are migrated automatically — “mine” is simply called “save” now.

opt_scLookup.message: Look up selection / word under cursor

opt_statusNotRunning.message: Gum is not running or the port is wrong.

opt_statusPullNeedsPairNow.message: Gum is not accepting a pull yet — press Pair now in Gum (Settings → Profile & dictionary → Chrome extension), then pull again within two minutes. Or copy the token there and paste it here.

opt_statusPullNoToken.message: App responded but sent no token — copy it manually from Settings.

opt_statusPullFailed.message: Could not pull — open Gum and paste the token manually.

opt_statusImportFailed.message: Could not import — the file is not a valid settings export.

opt_statusPanelRestored.message: The panel will show on all sites again.

tabs_hint.message: Select tabs and save them in one go — articles go to your Gum inbox, videos and playlists to YouTube tracking. The colored edge shows the detected source type (News, Novel, Manga, Video, Article). Download only applies to YouTube tabs.

tabs_empty.message: No tabs found in this scope.

tabs_badgeTitle.message: Detected source type (URL and title heuristics)

tabs_queuedNote_one.message: ($1 queued — will sync when Gum is open)

tabs_queuedNote_other.message: ($1 queued — will sync when Gum is open)

cmd_lookup_selection_desc.message: Open the reader popup for the selected or last-hovered text.

cmd_save_word_desc.message: Save the selected word to your Gum library.

cmd_save_sentence_desc.message: Save the selected or detected sentence to your Gum library.

cmd_card_create_desc.message: Create a flashcard from the selection (Anki when available; a copy always stays in Gum).

cmd_capture_page_desc.message: Save this page (article, video, or playlist) into Gum.

cmd_capture_ocr_desc.message: Drag a box over an image to recognize its text.

cmd_capture_audio_record_desc.message: Record microphone audio for the next Save audio.

cmd_capture_audio_save_desc.message: Save the last recording into Gum.

cmd_capture_manga_desc.message: Scan a long-strip / webtoon page and import the panels into Gum.

cmd_media_download_desc.message: Download the current YouTube video or playlist into Gum.

cmd_media_transcribe_desc.message: Transcribe the current video’s audio with Whisper and add it to the catalogue.

cmd_clipboard_send_desc.message: Add the selection to the Gum clipboard history.

cmd_translate_selection_desc.message: Translate the selection with the Gum translation model.

cmd_grammar_match_desc.message: Find grammar patterns in the selected sentence.

cmd_reader_theme_desc.message: Cycle the page reading theme (night, sepia, paper, gray).

cmd_reader_knownTint_desc.message: Tint words on the page by how well you know them.

cmd_tabs_picker_desc.message: Open the tab list to save several pages at once.

cmd_app_open_desc.message: Bring the Gum desktop app to the front.

cmd_settings_special_desc.message: Open the hidden Special modules settings page in Gum.

cmd_wheel_more_desc.message: Open the secondary action list (OCR, media, page tools).
